changelog:
- Initial release of ithome-rank skill for fetching IT之家 (ithome.com) daily, weekly, or monthly hot/ranking articles.
- Provides a Python script using `requests` (no browser required) to reliably parse and format top articles for easy retrieval.
- Supports scheduled or on-demand article list pushes to common messaging channels (WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Feishu, etc.).
- Includes detailed setup, usage, and troubleshooting instructions for pushing news and scheduling daily updates.
